coverage_issues: qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 failed to review .SRCINFO, .nvchecker.toml, and jetbrains-idea.desktop due to LLM API HTTP 400 errors.
learnings: Implement retry logic or graceful degradation for LLM API errors (e.g., HTTP 400) so that transient failures on specific files do not force an overall 'inconclusive' verdict when the rest of the package is successfully audited.

The adjudication layer should automatically detect tool errors (like API crashes) in one report and defer to a complete, successful report from another model rather than treating it as a genuine security disagreement.
